MANTIS

A hub for Monitoring with Automated and Novel Technologies based on Image and Sound

Sensors are already deployed across Europe. MANTIS aims to connect them into a transnational monitoring system, rather than isolated national deployments.

  • Biodiversa+ WP2 · Task 2.5.3 additional activity
  • Aarhus University with the Nature Conservation Agency CZ
  • 1 January 2027 – 30 September 2028
  • €796,850.18 requested
  • Core Activity 3 primary · CA2 and CA4 secondary

The proposal in one figure

The numbered gates on the connectors – deployment registration, expert verification, AI benchmarking, standards conformance – are what MANTIS adds. Most of what lies either side of them already exists in Europe.

What the activity does

Connect data acquisition – align protocols, deployments and annotations across partners. Extend spatial and taxonomic coverage with new sensor deployments. Package 1 · seven activities · Core Activity 2

Connect the data – harmonise datasets and metadata. Ensure flow from images and sounds to quality-controlled indicators, including transnational benchmarking of AI models. Package 2 · five activities · Core Activity 3, primary

Connect the community – link the users of these technologies to one another, and to the skills and resources that sustain a transnational effort. Package 3 · seven activities · Core Activity 4

Nineteen activities in all, with nine deliverables and sixteen milestones between 1 January 2027 and 30 September 2028. MANTIS could develop into a Thematic Hub associated with an EBOCC. It sets up no new operational structure: outputs are hosted on GitHub Pages, GBIF and Zenodo, and verification capacity rests on statutory Habitats and Birds Directive duties.

Objectives and deadlines

Target and indicator Deadline
O1 Deployment registration 100% of active AMI, CamAlien and acoustic deployments across ≥8 partner countries, registered and machine-readable in a Camtrap DP-compliant master database 30 Sep 2028
O2 Policy-relevant indicators ≥4 finalised indicators live on the MANTIS dashboard, each mapped to NRR Art. 10 / EU-PoMS, the Habitats Directive, the Birds Directive or IAS Regulation 1143/2014, and auto-updating from GBIF 30 Sep 2028
O3 Verified annotations ≥5,000 expert-verified annotations published under FAIR principles, including ≥2,000 NewtCam annotations; ≥20% reviewed by experts from ≥2 countries 31 Dec 2027
O4 Training 25 summer-school participants from ≥12 countries; ≥20 distinct organisations attending ≥1 of the 8 online events 30 Jun 2028
O5 Roadmap beyond 2028 Roadmap endorsed by ≥2/3 of partners at BioMonWeek 2028, naming ≥2 concrete funding or hosting pathways 30 Jun 2028

The devices, in the field

Three device families: AMI traps for nocturnal insects, acoustic recorders for birds, bats and amphibians, and the vehicle-mounted CamAlien for invasive plants along roads. These are existing partner deployments, which MANTIS would register, upgrade and benchmark.

Related initiatives

Schemes, projects and infrastructures that MANTIS builds on, feeds into, or stays interoperable with.

The partnership Biodiversa+ The European Biodiversity Partnership. MANTIS is an additional activity under WP2, Task 2.5.3. Pilot 2.6.2 IAS pilot Image-based monitoring of invasive alien species – an AMI trap and a CamAlien unit in ten countries. Takes on the registration system and the Camtrap DP implementations. Pilot 2.6.5 ABMS pilot Automated Biodiversity Monitoring Stations – AMI traps and acoustic recorders in three habitat types across eleven countries. Pilot 2.6.8 BiodivPond Standardised pond monitoring, with acoustic recorders in ten countries. The underwater acoustic pilot and the NewtCam annotations connect here. Horizon Europe MAMBO AI models for image and sound recognition in EU biodiversity monitoring. MANTIS reuses them for benchmarking instead of training its own. Biodiversa+ project TABMON Passive acoustic monitoring across four countries, producing EBVs from soundscapes. Shared metadata structures and acoustic pipelines. EU research results CORDIS The Commission's record of the EU-funded projects MANTIS builds on, MAMBO among them – factsheets, deliverables and results.
